eligibility_reason: The paper reports original quantitative estimates of exposure to unreliable information sources in Bing search results. The paper text is complete and not truncated.

estimates.measure: share of SERPs linking to an unreliable news source
estimates.misinfo_definition: NewsGuard-rated unreliable information sources: domains scoring below 60 out of 100
estimates.source_quote: In sample 1, around 1.4% of SERPs linked to an unreliable news source and 27% to reliable news sites.

estimates.measure: share of SERPs linking to an unreliable news source
estimates.misinfo_definition: NewsGuard-rated unreliable information sources: domains scoring below 60 out of 100
estimates.source_quote: In sample 2, around 0.9%ofSERPslinkedtoanunreliablenewssourceand41%toareli- able news site.

estimates.denominator: all top-three search results in sample 1
estimates.measure: share of top-three results linking to unreliable information sites
estimates.misinfo_definition: NewsGuard-rated unreliable information sources: domains scoring below 60 out of 100
estimates.source_quote: In sample 1, around 1.2% of the top 3 results link to unreliable information sites, compared to 1.4% overall.

estimates.denominator: all top-three search results in sample 2
estimates.measure: share of top-three results linking to unreliable information sites
estimates.misinfo_definition: NewsGuard-rated unreliable information sources: domains scoring below 60 out of 100
estimates.source_quote: In sample2,around 1.2% of the top 3 results link to unreliable information sites, compared to0.9%overall.

estimates.measure: share of rank-one results that were unreliable sites
estimates.misinfo_definition: NewsGuard-rated unreliable information sources: domains scoring below 60 out of 100
estimates.source_quote: For non-­ USNQ searches, less than 1% of the results at rank 1 were unreliable sites, while this value was around 90% for USNQ searches.

estimates.measure: share of rank-one results that were unreliable sites

considered_but_excluded.why: Share of searches classified as unreliable-site navigational queries, not prevalence of misinformation exposure or consumption.
Share of total unreliable exposure originating from navigational searches; composition within unreliable exposure, not overall prevalence.
Share of unreliable engagement originating from navigational searches; composition within unreliable engagement, not one of the specified constructs.
Likelihood of engaging with unreliable sites conditional on query type; engagement is not observed real-world sharing.
Classification performance measures, not misinformation prevalence.
